changelog:
CSM 1.0.874

Font Scale is temporarily hidden from Appearance, legacy settings and settings search due to instability. Existing and imported global font-scale values are inactive; CloudStream's native text sizing is used. App Font, letter spacing, line height and the system's accessibility font size are unchanged.

This is a feature withdrawal, not a claim that the scaler was repaired. Regression verification includes mounted modern/legacy settings callbacks, actual hub search and attached Compose text; physical-device rendering is not certified.
message: CSM Dev v874 - withdraw unstable global Font Scale
